description: This stacked bar chart illustrates the number of datasets over time, categorized by target type. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled "Year," with discrete years ordered chronologically from 2012 to 2022. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Number of datasets," utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 160 with tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at regular intervals of 20. Each bar is stacked to show two components based on a legend titled "Targets": the bottom segment is colored blue and represents "Untargeted" datasets, while the top segment is colored orange and represents a category whose text label is obscured by a solid grey rectangle. The total height of the bars varies across the years, with the shortest bars appearing in 2012 and 2013 at approximately 2 datasets each, and the tallest bar occurring in 2021 with exactly 160 datasets, consisting of roughly 67 blue and 93 orange datasets. The bars are sorted chronologically, and the final bar for the year 2022 is visually distinguished from the others by being rendered in lighter, faded shades of blue and orange, reaching a total approximate value of 37 datasets.
